000333.notes: Primary: Midea Q3 2026 report (cninfo PDF opened this time), 2025 annual results announcement (HKEX), Q3 2025 report (China Securities Journal e-paper, https://epaper.cs.com.cn/zgzqb/images/2025-10/30/B356/zqB35630.pdf). 9M 2026: net profit 41,393.371m, excl. non-recurring 28,787.970m, basic EPS 5.54, diluted 5.48; Q3 2026: 14,947.334m, excl. 9,192.791m. 9M 2025: 37,883.383m, excl. 37,140.080m, diluted EPS 4.97, non-recurring 743.3m. FY2025: 43,945m, basic EPS 5.80, diluted 5.76, excl. non-recurring 41.24bn (rounded by the company). TTM uses diluted EPS (basic would be 6.36). Non-recurring table 9M 2026: asset disposal 542.6; fair value and investment income on financial instruments 14,417.3 (Q3 alone 7,671.6); other 1,111.9; less tax 3,149.8 and minorities 316.6; total 12,605.4. Pre-tax 16,071.8 is my sum of gross lines. TTM non-recurring is about 12,605.4 + 2,705 - 743.3 = 14,567m, about 31% of TTM net profit. The Q3 report itself does not name ChangXin/CXMT; the attribution is from broker notes (Changjiang Securities via https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5344674: fair-value change gains +5.474bn yuan year on year in Q3 'mainly from CXMT listing'; another note, https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5346797, says the Q3 amount is mainly derivative fair-value changes and investment income, +7.13bn year on year, and that FX losses on monetary items (financial expenses swung from -0.76bn to +0.85bn in Q3) sit in recurring profit while the hedging gains are classed non-recurring). So part of the non-recurring gain offsets a recurring FX loss; the split between CXMT and hedging is not disclosed. Q1 2026 non-recurring total was 1,712.8m (https://epaper.cs.com.cn/zgzqb/images/2026-04/30/B326/zqB32630.pdf). Tax rate is my division: 9M 2026 income tax 9,334.1 / total profit 50,832.7 (FY2025: 8,565 / 53,085 = 16.1%). No company profit guidance.

000651.notes: 9M 2026 not primary (ifeng, 26 Oct 2026; filing not found): net profit 17.274bn, excl. non-recurring 16.403bn, basic = diluted EPS 3.09; Q3 net profit 3.996bn. Q3 2025 report (https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-10-31/1224779019.PDF): 9M 2025 net profit 21,461.337m, EPS 3.86, non-recurring 876.5m (government grants 700.9, fair value/disposal of financial assets 330.3, pre-tax). TTM non-recurring = 871 + 420.3 = about 1,291m, 5.2% of TTM net profit; it is the usual mix of government grants and fair-value gains at a similar level every year, no single large item. 002415.notes: 9M 2026 figures from a Stockstar copy of the Q3 2026 report (not the filing itself, so primary false): net profit 12,911.386m, basic = diluted EPS 1.409; Q3 5,015.681m, EPS 0.547; non-recurring total 215.8m in nine months (32.0m in Q3). Primary for the rest: 2025 annual report summary and Q1 2026 report (https://epaper.cs.com.cn/zgzqb/images/2026-04/18/B158/zqB15818.pdf): FY2025 net profit 14,195.372m, excl. non-recurring 13,703.158m, EPS 1.546; Q3 2025 report (https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202510171763891232_1.pdf): 9M 2025 net profit 9,319.125m, EPS 1.014, non-recurring 348.2m. TTM non-recurring = 215.8 + 492.2 - 348.2 = about 360m, 2.0% of TTM net profit: below the 3% threshold, so no one-off gain listed (items are government grants, small fair-value gains, an 18.3m debt-restructuring gain). No profit guidance (only a revenue expectation). The 10jqka page and the cninfo filing were not opened.

002668.notes: Primary: Q3 2026 report (Sina copy of the filing) and 2025 annual report summary (https://epaper.cs.com.cn/zgzqb/images/2026-03/11/B019/zqB01911.pdf). 9M 2026 net profit 775.408m (9M 2025: 977.436m), excl. non-recurring 729.913m, basic = diluted EPS 0.72 (0.90); FY2025 net profit 1,123.382m, excl. 1,122.058m, EPS 1.04 (Q4 2025 alone 145.946m). Non-recurring 9M 2026 total 45.5m after tax and minorities (fair value/disposal of financial assets 30.8m, reversal of receivable impairment 25.1m, government grants 9.8m, all pre-tax); FY2025 total 1.3m; 9M 2025 about 35.6m (derived from the -22.50% change). TTM non-recurring is about 45.5 + 1.3 - 35.6 = 11m, about 1.2% of TTM net profit: below the 3% threshold, none listed. The other way round, the company says a currency LOSS of about 284m depressed 9M 2026 profit (profit excluding FX 943m, +0.70%; from growth_facts, not re-opened). Tax rate is my division: 9M 2026 income tax 181.7 / total profit 1,632.5. No profit guidance.

300750.notes: All primary (CATL Q3 2026 report and 2025 annual report on cninfo). 9M 2026: net profit 64,530.063m, excl. non-recurring 57,875.782m, basic = diluted EPS 14.13; 9M 2025: 49,034.109m, EPS 11.02; FY2025: 72,201.282m, excl. non-recurring 64,507.864m, EPS 16.14 (Q4 2025 alone 23,167.173m). TTM = 9M 2026 + FY2025 - 9M 2025. Non-recurring 9M 2026 table: asset disposal 304.5, fair value/disposal of financial assets 2,990.5, receivable impairment reversal 1.6, other non-operating 94.9, other items (mainly other income) 6,393.5; less tax 2,164.5 and minorities 966.2; total 6,654.3 (Q3 alone 2,383.6). Pre-tax 9,784.9 is my sum of the gross lines. FY2025 total 7,693.4 is a subtraction; the 9M 2025 non-recurring total (about 5,413) is derived from the stated +32.68% growth of the excl. figure, so the Q4 2025 share (about 2,280) is approximate. TTM non-recurring is therefore roughly 8,930m, about 10% of TTM net profit; most of it is government-grant type 'other income' that recurs every year although the company classes it as non-recurring. Tax rate is my division: 9M 2026 income tax 11,529.6 / total profit 81,028.0. No company profit guidance.

600519.notes: The Q3 2026 report itself was opened this time (cninfo PDF, primary): nine-month net profit to shareholders 64,467.4 million yuan (-0.25%), Q3 19,950.5 million (+3.78%), basic and diluted EPS 51.53 for nine months (0.00% change) and 15.96 for Q3. TTM is arithmetic: 2025 net profit 82,320 million and basic EPS 65.66 (secondary: The Paper, 17 Apr 2026, https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32988235; Xinhua gives the same profit) minus nine months 2025 (about 64,629 million, derived from the -0.25% change; EPS 51.53 per the 0.00% change) plus nine months 2026. ttm.primary is false only because the 2025 full-year figures are from news reports; the annual report was not opened. No company profit guidance: the 2025 annual report set no revenue target for 2026 (Xinhua, Yicai). Non-recurring items are tiny: 142.6 million yuan after tax in nine months 2026 (fair-value and disposal gains on financial assets 121.3 million, government grants 34.4 million, other 40.7 million; before tax and minorities), about 0.2% of profit; net profit excluding them 64,324.8 million (-0.55%). 2025 non-recurring items not found. Tax rate 25.1% is computed for nine months 2026 (22,300.5 / 89,017.7).
